name: Higeki ~Nightmare Come True~
source:
Hero is a medical student, the son of a hospital manager. One day he receives a letter with instructions how to insult each of his girl acquaintances. He attacks the girls one after another. What's the truth behind insult instructions?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-january-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄是一名医科学生，是医院经理的儿子。有一天，他收到一封信，其中包含如何侮辱他所认识的每个女孩的指示。他一个接一个地攻击女孩们。侮辱指令背后的真相是什么？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-january-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
